records.title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: •In the aggregate, select net working capital items, specifically, trade accounts receivable, inventory, accounts payable and accrued liabilities, generated cash of $102.2 million in 2024, compared to consuming cash of $209.0 million in 2023.

records.title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: Despite specific actions taken to mitigate these gross margin pressures, we continue to experience overall declines in consumer demands for our products, and higher prices for direct materials used to manufacture our products were, and continue to be, the primary incremental cost to our business (see Consolidated Results of Operations included in this MD&A).

records.title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: Operating profit was $2,898.2 million in 2024 compared to $2,560.9 million in 2023, an increase of $337.3 million, or 13.2%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net sales for 2024 increased $516.1 million, or 3.0%, from $17.4 billion generated in 2023 to $17.9 billion generated in 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During 2024, U.S. commodity market prices for chicken products trended in line with historical averages to begin the year, but saw stronger seasonal increases in mid-first quarter as industry production declined relative to the prior year levels and domestic demand growth absorbed produced volumes and eroded cold storage inventories.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The change in inventories represented a $134.5 million source of cash in 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We generated consolidated operating margins of 8.4% with operating margins of 10.5%, 3.3%, and 10.6% in our U.S., Europe, and Mexico reportable segments, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income increased $983.8 million, or 188.4%, from $522.3 million generated for 2023 to $1,506.1 million generated for 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the December 2024 quarter, revenue increased 5% compared to the three months ended September 29, 2024 (the “September 2024 quarter”), driven by an increase in systems revenue as a result of strengthened memory investments in both the NAND and dynamic random access memory (“DRAM”) market segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The deferred revenue balance was $2,031.6 million at the end of the December 2024 quarter, a slight decrease relative to the balance at the end of the September 2024 quarter of $2,047.0 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in revenue for the six months ended December 29, 2024 compared to the same period in 2023 was due to increases in equipment spending by our customers across all market segments as well as higher customer support-related revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating expenses in the December 2024 quarter were flat compared to the September 2024 quarter, as increases in headcount and incentive compensation expense were largely offset by lower elective deferred compensation plan-related costs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This decrease was primarily the result of $697.7 million of share repurchases, including net share settlement of employee stock-based compensation and excise tax; $297.6 million of dividends paid to stockholders; and $188.3 million of capital expenditures; partially offset by $741.9 million of cash generated from operating activities.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Our year-over-year revenue decreased ($30.6) million to $375.2 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue for the three and six months ended December 29, 2024 as compared to the three and six months ended December 31, 2023 for our power product line decreased due to the softening of demand in industrial and energy applications.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The significant components of our working capital are liquid assets such as cash and cash equivalents, short-term investments, accounts receivable and inventories, partially reduced by accounts payable and accrued expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit and gross margin were impacted by a less favorable product mix resulting from the softening of demand for our products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, we have classified the results and cash flows of the RF product line as discontinued operations in our consolidated statements of operations and consolidated statements of cash flows for fiscal 2024.
